title: Stop Going in Circles:Loop-Triggered Routing for System 1 Decision Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.25363v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: System 1 decision models (represented by Jev) provide fast, low-cost action selection, but existing agent integrations do not reliably translate these local advantages into task completion. At certain points during execution, an agent may repeatedly select the same actions without making progress toward its goal. LLM-based policies offer strong reasoning capabilities that support planning within an agent, but invoking them at every step incurs substantial overhead. The effective coordination should therefore preserve Jev's fast local action selection while introducing LLM reasoning when execution stalls. We observe that recurring state-action pairs can signal stalled execution. We therefore propose LoopRoute, a simple but effective action router that uses this signal to allocate control within an agent. The decision model acts by default. When a loop is detected, the LLM provides brief, feedback-driven assistance and then returns control

translated_title: 停止原地打转：面向系统1决策智能体的循环触发式路由
translated_abstract: 系统1决策模型（以Jev为代表）能够提供快速、低成本的动作选择，但现有的智能体集成方式并不能可靠地将这些局部优势转化为任务完成能力。在执行过程中的某些时刻，智能体可能反复选择相同的动作，而无法向目标取得进展。基于LLM的策略具备强大的推理能力，可以支持智能体内部的规划，但在每一步都调用它们会产生巨大的开销。因此，有效的协调方式应当在保留Jev快速局部动作选择的同时，在执行停滞时引入LLM推理。我们观察到重复出现的状态-动作对可以作为执行停滞的信号。基于此，我们提出了LoopRoute，这是一种简单而有效的动作路由器，利用该信号在智能体内部进行控制权分配。默认情况下由决策模型执行动作；当检测到循环时，LLM提供简短的、基于反馈的辅助，然后将控制权交还。
tldr: 提出LoopRoute——一种循环触发的动作路由器，默认由快速低成本的系统1决策模型执行动作，仅在检测到重复状态-动作对（即执行陷入循环停滞）时才调用LLM进行简短的反馈式辅助，从而在不增加每步开销的情况下提升任务完成能力。
en_tdlr: LoopRoute is a simple yet effective loop-triggered action router that lets a fast, low-cost System 1 decision model act by default, invoking brief LLM feedback assistance only when recurring state-action pairs signal stalled execution, thereby improving task completion without per-step overhead.
